notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Alena.
Alena does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
You control a creature with power three or greater that has entered the battlefield this turn.
description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
Alena triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
